title: Power-up drop on death — dying bomber drops ~50% of their stats as pickups at death cell (Super Bomberman R staple)
intent: Per `docs/game-design/bomberman-1v1-dynamics-analysis.md §4.1`. Today, killing an opponent gives the survivor a tally point + nothing else. Survivors don't have an incentive to ENGAGE — they just need to not-die. Adopting the Super Bomberman R staple: when a bomber dies, ~50% of their collected stats (round-down) spawn as pickup entities at their death cell. Survivors race to grab. Result: kills become VALUABLE — both for tally AND for loot. 1v1 dynamics shift from 'orbit each other' to 'commit to attacks because kill = power spike'. Same mechanic indirectly helps with all three of the user-stated problems (boring 1v1, easy escape, hard cornering — see analysis doc §4.1).
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/bomberman-1v1-dynamics-analysis.md §4.1`. Adopts a 30-year-old proven solution from Super Bomberman 2-4 + Super Bomberman R series. Cheap to implement — reuses existing pickup-spawn-system and pickup-collect-system. ~100 LOC project-side. No engine changes. Highest impact-to-cost ratio in the 1v1 analysis batch.
acceptanceHints: TARGET FILE: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/death-pickup-drop-system.ts — NEW. Runs at the moment BomberStats.alive flips to false.
DROP RULE — when a bomber dies (alive=true → false):
Read their current stats: maxBombs, range, speed, canKick, canRemote, canShield, canPierce, canThrow, canBombPass.
Compute droppable inventory:
Numeric stats (bombs/fire/speed): drop floor(current / 2) pickups. E.g. bomber with maxBombs=4 drops 2 'bomb-up' pickups. Speed=3 → 1 'speed-up' drop.

Boolean flags (kick/remote/shield/pierce/throw/bomb-pass): 50% chance per flag to drop the corresponding pickup. Deterministic seeded — drop based on (bomber entity id + sceneSeed + round number) hash so same seed = same drops.

Total dropped pickup count is capped at 5 (avoid overwhelming the death cell). If computed count > 5, prioritise: numeric stats first (bombs > fire > speed), then booleans by rarity (Shield > Pierce > Remote > Kick > Throw > Bomb Pass).
PICKUP SPAWN LOCATIONS:
All dropped pickups spawn at the death CELL (bomber's last grid position before alive=false flip).

If multiple pickups at one cell: they spawn in a small radial pattern around the cell (slight visual offset for readability), but each occupies the same logical cell — bomber walking over the cell collects ALL of them (existing pickup-collect-system already handles multi-pickup-on-cell).
PICKUP ENTITY REUSE:
Use existing Pickup component + pickup-spawn-system spawn path. Drop spawns the same pickup-type entities that soft-block destruction normally spawns.
Same visual + same audio cue on collect. No new pickup types.
TIMING:
Pickups spawn at the moment alive=false flips — BEFORE the ragdoll launch from GDP-022-005. Bomber's logical position used for spawn; visual ragdoll launches from there.
Pickups visible immediately. Survivors race to grab from the moment ragdoll starts.
PICKUP LIFETIME:
Dropped pickups persist until collected OR until round ends OR until destroyed by another blast (existing pickup-blast-destruction rule).

Unlike normal pickups that persist until collected, dropped pickups have a SLIGHTLY FASTER decay if not collected: 30-second default lifetime. Forces commitment — survivor must engage to grab before they vanish.
VISUAL CUE on drop:
Small upward burst particle effect at the death cell — telegraphs 'loot dropped here'. Reuses existing particle emitter primitive.
Optional polish: pickup entities have a subtle 'shimmer' glow for the first 5 seconds (use existing pickup-glow shader from visual-style.md §3, with brighter intensity for the first 5s, then normal).
AUDIO:
New audio event 'loot-drop' — short rising chime on the death moment. Layered with existing death audio + ragdoll launch.
Voice synth: bomber's 'death' voice slot fires normally (existing). No new vocal slot for loot drop.
BOT AI INTERACTION:
Bot AI pickup magnet (S123) extends to dropped pickups — bots see them as high-priority cells.
When HUMANS_DEAD acceleration (GDP-2026-05-29-011) active, pickup magnet is DISABLED — bots focus on combat. Pickups become bonus loot for combat winner.
MULTIPLAYER (server-authoritative gameplay from S125):
Server-side death-pickup-drop-system mirrors client logic. Server's seeded RNG ensures all clients see same drops.
Snapshot includes the spawned pickup entities (existing pickup snapshot path).
DETERMINISM: drop count + boolean drop selection deterministic per (bomber id + round + scene seed). Bot-vs-bot regression test continues to resolve.
URL CONFIG:
`?lootDrop=off` disables — useful for testing classical bomberman behaviour.
`?lootDropRatio=N` overrides 0.5 ratio (clamped 0.0..1.0).
`?lootDropMax=N` overrides max-pickup cap of 5.
`?lootDropLifetimeS=N` overrides 30s lifetime.
TESTS:
Bomber with maxBombs=4 dies → 2 'bomb-up' pickups spawn at death cell.
Bomber with all 6 boolean flags + seeded hash → exactly 3 boolean pickups drop.
Total drop cap: bomber with maxBombs=6, range=4, speed=3, plus all flags → cap at 5 pickups, numeric first.
Spawn position: all drops at death cell (gridX, gridZ).
Multi-collect: bomber walks over death cell with 5 dropped pickups → collects all 5 in one tick.
Lifetime: pickup not collected within 30s → despawns.
Drop deterministic per (bomber id, round, seed) — same inputs = same drops.
?lootDrop=off → zero pickups spawn on death.
VISUAL QA:
Player kills opponent → opponent's stats spray as pickup pile at death cell.
Player walks over the cell → collects pickups, HUD updates with new stats.
In 1v1 with Sudden Death: kills become hot moments — survivor races to grab loot before walls close in on death cell.
DOCS UPDATES IN THIS PR:
gameplay-systems.md §5 power-up section — note 'power-up drops on death' as a rule.
gdd.md §Round structure — note loot drop changes incentive to engage.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Per-personality drop preferences (Coward drops boolean flags first, Hunter drops numeric first). Uniform rule.
Tradeable loot drops (player can pick up + voluntarily put down). Single direction.
Visual loot animations (pickups falling from corpse). Stays simple at death cell.
Per-pickup-type drop probability tuning (all flag drops use 50%). Uniform.
Bot-vs-bot loot scrambles when humans dead (GDP-2026-05-29-011) — explicitly bots ignore loot during acceleration to focus on kill.
